facts.text: I am trying to establish a consistent cleaning routine.
I want advice on how to keep my bedroom tidy.
I am looking for natural cleaning products to use for tough stains.
I have been using a natural all-purpose cleaner from a health food store.
My natural all-purpose cleaner does not work as well on tough stains.
I have been using Dr. Bronner's castile soap as a natural all-purpose cleaner.
I am not sure if Dr. Bronner's castile soap is strong enough to tackle tougher stains.
I am considering using Dr. Bronner's Sal Suds for tougher stains.
I think I will dilute Dr. Bronner's Sal Suds with water and test it on a small area first.
I am considering mixing Dr. Bronner's Sal Suds with my all-purpose castile soap for a stronger cleaning solution.
I want to use Dr. Bronner's Sal Suds to clean my bathroom shower and sink area.
I want to know whether Dr. Bronner's Sal Suds would be effective for removing soap scum and mildew.

keyphrases: mix Sal Suds with castile soap
